title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: Put a score on the drill
hook: Watch what happens when you add a score to a drill.
intro: The passing drill is the same as last week.
Half the team is going through the motions.
statement: A score turns repetition into a reason to try.
q1: Do you keep score in every drill —
q2: or keep some drills free from winning and losing?
q3: Which players lean in when there is a score?
t1: Every team is different. But focus comes faster
t2: when the drill has something to play for.
cta: Coaches — do your drills keep score?
ctaLines: First to ten. Beat your own record. Team versus coach.
Score everything or keep it low-key?
ctaPrompt: Share your drill habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Watch what happens when you add a score to a drill.
The passing drill is the same as last week. Half the team is going through the motions.
A score turns repetition into a reason to try.
Score every drill or keep some just for practice. There is no perfect answer.
Do your drills keep score? Share your habit in the comments.
